name: OpenArcade · 午夜街机
description: A plug-and-play micro-gaming hall built for her, open to everyone. The portal, host strategy, and game cartridges are completely separate; new games are integrated via SDK without affecting the host state. 30 cartridges have been launched, all of which are deterministic, replayable, and constructively solvable.

name: pptx-storyboard · 分镜成片
description: Convert PowerPoint original animations into video with explanations: analyze animation timestamps per page, automatically split scenes, generate narration, produce neural voiceover, and finally render a 1080p video with subtitles. All operations run locally, and a 19-page lesson set took only 7 minutes to produce the final video.

name: dsh-session-surgeon
description: DeepSeek Harness Conversation Emergency Plugin: Fixes conversation files that cannot open (seq gaps, zstd corruption, isolated agents), and can also copy the conversation ID to a new dialogue to continue the conversation. It is also my first project to reach the star rating.

name: CC Switch Auth Converter
description: A pure static single-page tool with just an index.html file, zero dependencies, and no build process. It converts any Codex or ChatGPT authentication JSON into an auth.json file compatible with CC Switch, ensuring tokens remain on the device itself.

name: 我的博客
description: The website you are viewing is built based on the open-source blog project 2025-blog, where the frontend serves as the backend: you can write and manage content without writing code. It features records of frontend development, exploration, and notes.

name: multi-tool
description: Designed for a multi-functional small tool on Linux desktop based on niri + noctalia-shell, written in QML.
